establishedCauses.scope: Code behavior; not a verified hosted incident diagnosis
establishedCauses.trigger: A new push arrives while the previous generic Jessie notification remains displayed.
establishedCauses.before: All received messages used the same tag jessie-new-message with renotify:false. Replacements did not request another audible/vibration alert.
establishedCauses.after: The same single generic notification is retained, with renotify:true requesting a fresh device alert for each received push.
establishedCauses.proof: VM inspection of HEAD and working source for two successive opaque message references: before flags [false,false], after [true,true], same tag and latest reference preserved.
establishedCauses.limit: The browser and OS still decide how to signal under device permissions and settings; sound/vibration is not guaranteed.

establishedCauses.scope: Reconnection UX after an inactive server preference
establishedCauses.before: A browser subscription with granted permission but server status enabled:false was described only as notifications off.
establishedCauses.after: Explicit reconnect status/button, localized FR/EN. A click reuses the existing browser subscription after fresh account proof and enables only the current role preference; no automatic POST, permission prompt, reset or other-device action.
establishedCauses.proof: Admin and client VM cases verify no POST during preparation, Reconnect button, one role-scoped POST on explicit click, no subscribe()/permission call, and confirmed enabled state.
establishedCauses.limit: Local subscription existence does not prove why its server preference is inactive. No specific real account state was inspected.

establishedCauses.scope: Shared second-audit fix coordinated with delivery_review
establishedCauses.before: 401 errors, including old asynchronous request errors, could clear the role cookie.
establishedCauses.after: Error responses never set a deletion cookie; absent/malformed sessions remain denied and existing Origin/CSRF checks remain enforced.
establishedCauses.proof: Updated malformed-token/POST/service-error contracts and delayed A / replacement B / late401 tests for both roles.

pipelineReview.enqueue: server/chat/store.mjs installs enqueueNotification inside its append transaction. Configured server composes the same callback when notifications are enabled; duplicates do not append twice.
pipelineReview.recipient: enqueueNotification selects the opposite participant’s enabled subscriptions; one outbox delivery per selected subscription.
pipelineReview.eligibility: Store rechecks current active participants, admission, source session revocation/credentials, subscription generation, message deletion and read receipt before transport. Normal session expiry alone intentionally does not cancel the opted-in subscription.
pipelineReview.visibility: Service worker has no foreground/hidden suppression. The server deliberately skips already-read messages; this is distinct from a missing unread push.
pipelineReview.worker: Poll 2 seconds, at most5 claimed jobs; lease90seconds; up to6 attempts; retryable provider errors get bounded backoff. Worker requests TTL no longer than24hours or the useful message window. No timing or quota changed.
pipelineReview.origin: Service-worker registration and requests remain relative to the current origin. Old recipe subscriptions/clicks remain recipe; primary activation remains independent. No automatic permission migration or origin switching.
pipelineReview.click: Opaque role-bound reference routes to /messages or /admin/messages, remains in the fragment, and live chat handoff preserves the browsing context; no message text/name/attachment is present in the alert.
